posts.text: Midterms were RIGGED by people who VOTED. Very unfair. The Senate changed colour overnight, like a mood ring. Tremendous mood ring, nobody has a bigger one.
Told you folks: midterms are where hope goes to get a recount. Proud of every intern who knocked on a door. And of the doors.
Counted the midterm votes myself with an AI. It says 42. Launching a rocket to the Senate to get a second opinion.
THE NATION WANTS TO KNOW why American TV calls races in 6 hours when our counting takes 6 weeks and 6 debates! Tonight 9 PM, 14 panelists, 0 answers.
In America the opposition won. I am studying the technique. Step one: have an election. Step two: still working on it.
Mitron, Amrika ke chunav dekh kar mann prasann hai. Hamare yahan 7 phase, unke yahan ek din. Hamara loktantra zyada lambi chalta hai.
This handle does not exist and must be dropped.
BREAKING: Governor race decided by 312 votes and one very persuasive aunty in a parking lot. Live from the parking lot.
Sab mile hue hain. The war room in my muffler says otherwise.

events.title: Winter session starts with a walkout
events.text: Parliament's winter session opened and the opposition walked out before the national anthem finished echoing. The canteen reports record samosa sales.

ch.r: You walked out, then walked back in for the samosas.
You gave a fiery speech to 11 people and a sleeping marshal.
The samosa was excellent. The CCTV footage was also excellent.

events.title: New portal crashes on day one
events.text: A shiny new government portal for ration cards went down within an hour of launch. Its homepage still says 'Digital India'.

ch.r: The vendor blamed the server. The server blamed the vendor.
The paper counter had a 3-hour queue and zero downtime.
